name: DEVANSHU GUPTA
pullQuote: “If I had to describe my journey with MAC in three words, they would be home, growth, and unforgettable. Nine-hour meetings never felt long when surrounded by people you genuinely care about.”
fullLetter: Leading the club through an intense transitional cycle challenged our fundamentals. We reconstructed the entire corporate pitch architecture, initiated the first-ever high-frequency research bulletin, and established institutional pipelines that yielded record-breaking attendance across Delhi University.
To the next cohort: execute without fear. Respect the craft, protect your team, and remember that real marketing begins where the textbook ends.
